title: make update-golden should work in headless environments
description: On machines without a display (SSH, containers), `make update-golden` and `make run` fail because the observer JVM needs Swing/AWT. Two prerequisites: (1) the full JDK (not just headless) must be installed — `java-21-openjdk` not just `java-21-openjdk-headless` — so AWT/Swing libraries are available, and (2) a virtual framebuffer like Xvfb must provide a DISPLAY. With `sudo dnf install java-21-openjdk xorg-x11-server-Xvfb` and `export DISPLAY=:99`, golden tests work. The Makefile should auto-detect this and either start Xvfb or error with a clear message about missing dependencies. Alternatively, add headless guards to ObserverMain.java so it doesn't need a display at all in noWindow mode (guard SplashScreen, Toolkit, and JFrame creation).
